abstract:
Author(s): Vít Jakubský, B. Manjarrez-Montañez, Rafael A. Méndez-Sánchez, and Yonatan Betancur-Ocampo

We investigate the spectral and topological properties of an atomic chain of red phosphorus. We reveal the separation of flat-band states from the rest of the system and calculate its energy bands analytically. title: Dimensional crossover of bound complexes in a two-species Bose-Hubbard lattice: Correlations and dynamics
authors: Deepak Gaur, Koushik Mukherjee, and Stephanie M. Reimann
abstract:
Author(s): Deepak Gaur, Koushik Mukherjee, and Stephanie M. Reimann

We study the equilibrium and nonequilibrium formation of four-particle complexes in a balanced two-species Bose-Hubbard model with repulsive intraspecies and attractive interspecies interactions.
